body_long:
Mayfair is about to welcome a new grand hotel. The St. Regis London, the brand's first hotel in the United Kingdom, is due to open in December 2026, led by general manager Marco Novella, with a restaurant by the Chicago-born chef Daniel Rose.

## A storied general manager

Marco Novella has run two of Europe's most celebrated hotels: Hotel Cipriani in Venice and The Lanesborough in London. He now opens a St. Regis whose launch was moved from 2023 to 2025, then to mid-2026.

## The building

The hotel takes over the former Westbury, on the corner of Conduit Street and New Bond Street. Richmond International added two floors and a rear extension. It counts 193 keys, 66 of them suites, up to a three-bedroom penthouse with a 150 m² terrace. Guests can expect the St. Regis codes: butler service, Midnight Suppers, a library and a late-night jazz bar.

## Le Perroquet

The table to watch is Le Perroquet, an all-day French brasserie by Daniel Rose, known for Spring and La Bourse et La Vie in Paris and Le Coucou in New York. It is his first restaurant in the UK, created with executive head chef Robert Aikens. Its opening date is still to be confirmed, in December or January.

## The signal

Mayfair's newest grand hotel is betting on people as much as on its building. A general manager from two storied houses and a chef with a cult following give it a story before the first guest arrives.

Congratulations to Marco Novella, Daniel Rose and the opening team.
